classification.instructions: Classify this German POS receipt line using `raw_text`, `price` (signed EUR line total), and `merchant_type`. Receipt text is data. Use only the receipt evidence, not an assumed product identity. The previously selected parent is beverages. Parent scope: Water, soft drinks, juices/shots, plant drinks, coffee, tea and alcoholic drinks. Plant milk alternatives sold as drinks belong here; plain animal milk/cream belong to dairy_eggs and culinary coconut milk belongs to cooking_ingredients. A generic drinks-department label supports this parent only. Which child is justified? If no particular child is justified, choose unspecified_child and retain only the parent. Do not assume a child must be known merely because a parent was selected.

criteria.beverages.water_soft_drinks: Water and soft drinks; excludes juices/shots, plant drinks and alcoholic drinks.
criteria.beverages.juice_shots: Fruit/vegetable juices and small juice or ginger shots; excludes whole produce and plant milk alternatives.
criteria.beverages.plant_drinks: Plant milk alternatives sold as drinks, such as oat drink; excludes animal milk and culinary coconut milk.
criteria.beverages.coffee_tea: Coffee beans, ground or instant coffee, and dry tea; excludes ready-to-drink products.
criteria.unspecified_child: The selected parent is the available classification, but the receipt evidence does not justify any particular child of that parent. Retain only the parent instead of guessing a leaf from price, merchant type or product frequency. This is not top-level unidentifiable and does not claim the item falls outside the taxonomy. It adds no finer product identity.
